# teams_phone_number_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a phone number to a user or resource account via Set-CsPhoneNumberAssignment / Get-CsPhoneNumberAssignment / Remove-CsPhoneNumberAssignment. The target needs the matching license: for a resource account a Teams Phone Resource Account license, plus a calling plan or Communications Credits for calling_plan numbers. Any change requires replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "teams_resource_account" "support" {
  user_principal_name = "support-queue@example.onmicrosoft.com"
  display_name        = "Support queue"
  type                = "call_queue"
}

# The resource account needs a Teams Phone Resource Account license, plus a
# calling plan or Communications Credits for calling_plan numbers.
resource "teams_phone_number_assignment" "support" {
  identity          = teams_resource_account.support.id
  phone_number      = "+18005550100"
  phone_number_type = "calling_plan"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Object id of the resource account or user.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number in E.164 form, e.g. +18005550100.
- `phone_number_type` (String) Number type: calling_plan, direct_routing or operator_connect.

### Optional

- `location_id` (String) Emergency location id for the number. When unset, the location Teams reports is kept.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <identity>/<phone_number>.
